# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner | Orchestrates Kent Beck-style RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner | Executes one complete TDD cycle: RED → GREEN (with retry) → REFACTOR |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner | Determines next test increment using LLM context |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent | Generates code (test, implementation, refactor) via LLM prompts |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod | Python TDD execution pod: runs RED/GREEN/REFACTOR with WorkerAgent + PodmanOrchestrator |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod | Go TDD execution pod |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod | TypeScript TDD execution pod via vitest |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner | Manages rootless Podman container lifecycle and pulse execution |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator | Sidecar execution layer with security hash verification |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter | Validates generated code against forbidden imports and blocked builtins |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge | Parses Gherkin .feature file into FeatureSpec |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent | Full autonomous TDD agent with ensemble learning and test review |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager | CRUD operations for playbooks with delta updates and persistence |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval | Hybrid retrieval engine for relevant playbook bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication | Semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks with provenance |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module | Analyzes execution outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module | Synthesizes insights into actionable playbook updates |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner | Orchestrates multi-model parallel learning with cross-voting |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger | Unified experiment logger for TDD and ML experiments with DB fallback |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector semantic search |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator | Aggregates agent performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, vLLM, Ollama) |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding | Local embedding generation using sentence-transformers |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map | Builds AST-based context maps for code generation |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator | Measures experiment success rates across system |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod run data |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager

    User->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_file)
    activate Runner

    loop over cycles (max iterations)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(...)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
        deactivate Planner

        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        alt RED phase
            Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
            Worker-->>Pod: test_code
            Pod->>Container: pulse(test_files)
            Container-->>Pod: PhaseResult (failing)
            Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
            deactivate Pod
            Note right of Cycle: RED must fail
        end

        loop up to max_green_attempts
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            Pod->>Container: pulse(test + impl files)
            Container-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
            deactivate Pod
            opt green_result.passed == false
                Cycle->>Pod: retry with error_feedback
            end
        end

        Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Container: pulse(refactored files)
        Container-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
        deactivate Pod

        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle

        opt green passed and reflector+curator configured
            Runner->>Reflector: reflect(task, generator_output, environment_feedback)
            activate Reflector
            Reflector-->>Runner: ReflectorOutput
            deactivate Reflector
            Runner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            activate Curator
            Curator-->>Runner: CuratorOutput (delta_bullets)
            deactivate Curator
            Runner->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
            activate Playbook
            Playbook-->>Runner: added bullet IDs
            deactivate Playbook
        end

        Runner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        activate Logger
        Logger-->>Runner: logged
        deactivate Logger

        alt planner says complete
            Note right of Runner: exits if planner indicates complete
            Runner-->>User: IterativeResult
            break
        end
    end

    deactivate Runner
```
